sources.title: Introducing Vinci MLE 1.0: open-weight models for ML engineering
sources.snippet: Vinci MLE 1.0 introduces 8B and 30B open-weight research models developed by SimpleDirect® in Canada, building on IBM Granite 4.1 and released under Apache-2.0. Their specialization focuses on inspecting experiment evidence, diagnosing problems, and making bounded changes.
